architectureDecisions: At research baseline 98807682, Oracle implementation still lives in packages/agentic-system/src/oracle.js and packages/oracle is absent. BB-060..063 are READY plans, not delivered capability. BB-064 execution therefore begins only after all four tasks are DONE and their implementation-result plus independent ACCEPT judgment artifacts agree with the delivered source; any mismatch is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

Close the logical/physical gap with one versioned machine-readable current-truth file, docs/living/system/oracle/architecture-alignment.json. It declares oracle/infrastructure as logical owner, packages/oracle as the only pull implementation root, packages/agentic-system/src/oracle.js as the Application semantic adapter, Application -> Oracle as the only dependency direction, the two fixed reader ports, Application-owned manifest/recovery/schema authority, and the four prerequisite delivery-evidence refs.

Add scripts/oracle-architecture-guard.mjs as a deterministic repository verifier and reusable exported function. It loads the alignment contract, package manifests, production ESM sources, Living Oracle docs and work graph; it rejects an invalid contract, missing/narrowed package exports, pull/read loops outside packages/oracle, Oracle imports of Agentic Application/Core or manifest/recovery modules, reversed/missing dependency metadata or source imports, generic provider/registry exports, stale docs and incomplete BB-060..063 delivery evidence.

Extend test/oracle-architecture-boundary.test.mjs with isolated temporary-tree mutations that independently prove the guard fails for copied Application read loops, reverse imports/dependencies, Oracle-owned schema/manifest/recovery authority, a falsified logical owner/root, missing accepted prerequisite evidence and docs/source disagreement. Tests call the same exported guard used by CI rather than a test-only checker.

Add packages/agentic-system/test/oracle-phase-acceptance.test.js around public Application APIs and the delivered manifest-protected durable composition. One scenario must drive exact repositoryRef/revision/path reads through the thin Application adapter and @exharness/oracle pull, accept Backend output, persist the exact manifest ref, discard producer/workflow/store/reader instances, reconstruct fresh persisted state, scope QA with forManifest(exactRef), and assert exact artifact request, sourceRef, APPLICATION_ARTIFACT provenance, no Backend rerun and successful QA submission.

The phase acceptance test complements rather than replaces BB-060..063 tests: it proves one cross-boundary composition while their unit/connectivity/durability matrices remain mandatory. Direct mode and the absence of a production repository/MCP adapter remain unchanged.

Wire npm run verify:oracle-architecture into the repository verify path so future ordinary CI cannot claim zero Oracle debt while the guard fails. The command runs the production alignment verifier and its negative-fixture test; no external service or install step is introduced.

Phase closure evidence is existing immutable delivery evidence, not a new self-authored verdict. The guard requires BB-060..063 status DONE, each graph outputRefs pair, IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT status PRODUCED, JUDGMENT verdict ACCEPT, matching item/candidate linkage and current Living refs before BB-064 can pass. BB-064 still requires its own Worker evidence and Jev judgment through the normal delivery pipeline.

On delivery, synchronize Oracle architecture/state/semantics/workflow and affected Agentic Application docs to the observed package topology, fixed ports, protected/direct behavior, external-adapter deferral and zero known reconciliation debt. Documentation cannot override a failing executable alignment guard.
